Landing.hero_subtitle: Xarunta dhamaystiran ee dowladaha xeebta Afrika si ay u kormeeraan, maamulaan, oo ay u hagaajiyaan xeerarka kaarboonka ee madaxbannaan. Xawaareyso abuurista dakhliga cimilada adoo isticmaalaya sawirka xogta AIS ee wakhtiga dhabta ah.
Landing.trusted_by: DOWLADAHA MADAXBANNAAN IYO SHURAAKADA AYAA INNAGA AAMINSAN
Landing.cap_tax_desc: Xisaabinta tooska ah iyo nidaamyada ururinta canshuuraha gaadiidka badda ee dhex mara biyaha madaxbannaan.
Landing.cap_credits_desc: Xaqiijinta iyo saarista dhameys tiran ee deynta kaarboonka ee heerka dowladnimada ah ee cad — ku habboon dhulalka xeebta.
Landing.cap_ais_desc: Raadraaca wakhtiga dhabta ah ee gaadiidka badda iyo basaska soo saarka CO₂ ee dhulalka xeebta.
Landing.simulation_subtitle: Xisaabi si degdeg ah dakhliga canshuurta kaarboonka ee suurtogalka ah iyadoo la raacayo taraafikada biyahaaga madaxbannaan.
Landing.sim_emissions_label: Soo Saarka Celceliska ah ee Markab kasta (tCO₂)
Landing.sim_days_in_zee: Celceliska Maalmaha ZEE ee Markab kasta
Landing.sim_trees_label: geedaha la beeray ee la mid ah
Landing.sim_disclaimer: Xisaabaadka waxa lagu saleeyaa habka IMO adoo la isticmaalaya moodeelka shuruucda cube si loo qiyaaso isticmaalka shidaalka. Natiijooyinka dhabta ah waxa ku xiran astaamaha gaarka ah ee markab kasta, nooca shidaalka, iyo xaalada abaaraha ee xadka EEZ.
Landing.sovereign_desc: Boggaaga AIS waxa uu bixiyaa kaabayaasha tknoolajiyada ee loo baahan yahay si loo hirgeliyo Maqaallada 6.2 iyo 6.4 ee Heshiiska Paris, taas oo hubinaysa daahfurnaanta iyo xisaabaadka suuqyada kaarboonka.
Landing.sovereign_feat1: Waafaqsan xeerarka caalamiga ah ee gaadiidka badda
Landing.sovereign_feat2: Isdhexgalka xogta satalaytka ee wakhtiga dhabta ah
Landing.sovereign_feat3: Diiwaanka amniga leh ee blockchain-ku taageeray ee macaamiilada
Landing.sovereign_tracking_title: Raadraaca Soo Saarka ee Toos ah
Landing.hero_title: Maamulka Deegaanka ee Madaxbannaan ee Hay'adaha Dowladda
Landing.capabilities_subtitle: Nidaam midaysan oo loogu talagalay kormeerka, warbixinta, iyo xaqiijinta hantida deegaanka ee xadudaha qaranka.
Landing.cap_emission_desc: Falanqaynta basaska kaarboonka ee wakhtiga dhabta ah adoo isticmaalaya habab waafaqsan IPCC — gaar ahaan loo habeeyay nidaamyada deegaanka Afrika.
Landing.cap_payment_desc: Habab sahlan oo fariimaadka lacag-bixinta ee xadudaha u dhaafaya — loogu talagalay deynta kaarboonka, canshuuraha deegaanka, iyo xiddigyada cagaaran.
Landing.cap_monitoring_desc: Sawirka satalaytka ee isku-dhafan ee heerarka fallaarista, tilmaamayaasha tayada biyaha, iyo goobaha noolaha kala duwan.
Landing.admin_desc: Ku beddel xaashidaha kala firirsan xarunta taliska oo xidid ah. GreenGate waxa uu u suurtogaliyaa wasaaradaha inay si ammaan ah isu kaashadaan, ay u xilsaaraan hawlaha xisaabaadka, oo ay tiro gudis ah diyaariyaan warbixinta buuxinta.
Landing.financial_desc1: U bedel ilaalinta deegaanka xoog dhaqaale. Barnaamijkayagu waxa uu bixiyaa xogta la xaqiijiyay ee loo baahan yahay si loo saaro xiddigyada cagaaran, loo ganacsado deynta kaarboonka, oo loo soo jiito maalgashiga cimilada ee caalamiga ah.
Landing.financial_desc2: Si toos ah ugu xidho suuqyada kaarboonka caalamiga ah adoo isticmaalaya albaabadayada API ee amni leh — si loo hubiyo qiimo xaq ah ee khayraadka qaranka.
Landing.impact_subtitle: Tilmaamayaasha wakhtiga dhabta ah ee ka imaanaya hay'adaheenna wadaaga ee muujinaya cabbirka xukuumadda deegaanka.
Landing.design_subtitle: Barnaamijkayagu waxa uu u dhisan yahay si uu u xaliyo caqabadaha gaar ah ee ku heysta wasaaradaha deegaanka iyo hay'adaha dowladda.
Landing.feat_sovereignty_desc: Lahaanshaha oo dhamaystiran iyo xukuumadda xogta deegaanka qaranka iyadoo la heli karo goobaha martigelinta ee maxalliga ah.
Landing.feat_policy_desc: Qalabka horudhac ahaan loo habeeyay si waafaqsan Ajandaha 2063 ee Midowga Afrika iyo shuruucda NDC ee Heshiiska Paris.
Landing.feat_deployment_desc: Dhismaha qaybaha ah waxa uu u suurtogaliyaa hay'adaha inay bilowdaan astaamaha xeeladda ah toddobaadyo gudood, ma ahan sano.
Landing.feat_interop_desc: Si sahlan ugu xidha kaabayaasha IT ee dowladda ee jira iyo hay'adaha warbixinta caalamiga ah.
Landing.faq_subtitle: Hel jawaabaha ku saabsan hirgelinta, buuxinta, iyo amniyadda.
Landing.ready_title: Ma diyaar baad u tahay isbeddel ka geynta xukuumadda deegaankaaga?
Landing.ready_subtitle: Ku biir shabakadda dowladaha fikirka hore leh ee isticmaalaya xogta si ay u ilaaliyaan dhaxalkooda dabiiciga ah oo ay u amninaaan mustaqbalkooda dhaqaale.
Landing.teaser_about_desc: Solide Technology waa shirkad 100% Afrikaan ah oo dib u xaqiijinaysa dowladaha qaaradda credibility-geeda ahaan wadaad istiraatijiyad ah oo lagu kobciyo qiimaha khayraadka deegaanka iyo cagaaran. DNA-geena ee Afrika oo keliya waxa ka baxsan sumadda.
Landing.teaser_african_desc: Jiil cusub oo hoggaamiyeyaasha Afrika ah oo qaata mas'uuliyadda taariikhda ah si Afrika u go'aansato nafteeda.
Landing.teaser_blockchain_desc: Raad-raaca, madax-bannaanida, iyo xukuumadda gelitaanka xogta — la damaanad qaatay xagga khiyaanada iyo been-abuurka.
Landing.teaser_expertise_desc: Fahmid qoto dheer oo xaaladaha dhaqaale-bulsheed ee maxalliga ah loogu talagalay xalal wax ku ool ah oo la qabsiiyay.
Landing.teaser_greengate_desc: Barnaamij blockchain-salaysan oo kacsan oo u suurtogaliya dowladaha Afrika inay qaataan xal dijital oo loogu talagalay ururinta canshuuraha kaarboonka iyo deegaanka — ugu horrayntii lala shaqeeyay dowladda yar ee Somaliland.

CarbonTax.hero_subtitle: La socod xilliyada dhabta ah ee ururinta cashuurta carboonka ee maraakiibta gudbaya ZEE-ga Somaliland. La socod hoggaansan IMO CII, EU ETS, MARPOL, iyo Qaab-dhismeedka Madaxbanaanaha ee Green Gate.
CarbonTax.rates_subtitle: Heerarka tixraaca ee ku haboon gaadiidka badda ee sida sharciga caalamiga ah iyo Qaab-dhismeedka Madaxbanaanaha ee Green Gate.
CarbonTax.vessels_subtitle: Xaalada hoggaansan ee hadda ee dhammaan maraakiibta ku jira Zonka Dhaqaale-gaar ee Somaliland.
CarbonTax.revenue_subtitle: Faahfaahinta dakhliga bishiiba oo lagu kala saaro nooca markabka 12 bilood ee la soo dhaafay.
CarbonTax.compliance_subtitle: Dulmar ku saabsan dhammaan xeerarka caalamiga ah ee ku tataban cashuurta carboonka badda iyo mas'uuliyadda shidaalka.
CarbonTax.compliance_disclaimer: Dulmarkan xeerarka waa macluumaad uun. Green Gate waxay ka shaqaysaa Qaab-dhismeedka Deegaanka Madaxbanaanaha ee Somaliland waxayna aqoonsataa dhammaan heshiisyada caalamiga ah ee ku haboon. Maamulayaasha maraakiibtu waxay la tashanaan karaan dawladooda calanka iyo qareenka sharcigu si ay u ogaadaan waajibiyaadkooda hoggaansan oo xaqiiq ah.
CarbonTax.imo_title: IMO Waxay Ansaxisay Kharashka Caalamiga ah ee Ugu Horeeyay ee Carboonka ee Maraakiibta
CarbonTax.imo_desc: Abriil 2025-kii, Hay'adda Maritime-ka Caalamiga ah (IMO) waxay cod siisay ansaxinta Qaab-dhismeedka Net-Zero ee IMO — markii ugu horreysay ee warshadeed oo dhan ay dejisay qiimo xidhnaanaya sharci ah oo carboonka ah oo heer caalami ah. Green Gate waxa loo dhisay in ay ka gawriiriso dawladaha Afrika inay helaan qaybtoodda dakhligaan.
CarbonTax.imo_pricing_desc: Qaab-dhismeedka IMO waxa uu dejiyaa qiimaha carboonka $100 iyo $380 khadka tonkasta oo CO₂ ah, oo ay weheliyaan credits-ka cashuurta la wareeji karo. Makiinadda qiimaha cashuurta ee Green Gate ee la habeynayo waxay taageeraysaa heer kasta oo qiimeeyn ah.
CarbonTax.imo_gfi_desc: Diiwaanka GFI cusub ee IMO wuxuu raacaa xoogga shidaalka sanadlaha ah ee kasta oo maraakiib ka mid ah. Raacidda AIS iyo xisaabaadka shidaalka ee Green Gate si toos ah ayay ugu galayaan shuruudaha warbixinta GFI.
CarbonTax.imo_compliance_desc: Maraakiibtuna waxay u baahan yihiin inay u soo gudbin IMO GFI-dooda la gaaray sanadkiiba. Green Gate waxay bixisaa kormeer hoggaansan oo wakhtiga dhabta ah oo ka dhan ah heerarka CII ee IMO, si loo hubiyo in dawladaha madaxbanaanaha ay xakamayn karaan qaab-dhismeedka.
CarbonTax.imo_cta_ascr: Arag sida aan uga dhex galayno Diiwaanka Carboonka Madaxbanaanaha ee Afrika

CarbonCredit.hero_badge: MACLUUMAADKA SARREEYA EE CREDITS-KA CARBOONKA MADAXBANAANAHA
CarbonCredit.hero_subtitle: Raac soo-saarka credits-ka carboonka madaxbanaanaha ee Somaliland, la socod xad-dheeraadka suuqyada ikhtiyaariga ah (VCS, Gold Standard, ICVCM/CCP, ACMI, Paris Art. 6), oo maamul mashruucyada gobolka.
CarbonCredit.market_subtitle: Qiimayaasha tixraaca khadka tCO₂ ee heerarka shahaadadda kala duwan. Xogta waxaa laga soo qaatay MSCI Global Carbon Credit Price Index, Regreener.earth, iyo carboncredits.com (2024–2025).
CarbonCredit.market_disclaimer: Qiimayaasha suuqyadu waa celcelisyo tilmaameed oo ah Q1 2025 waxayna si weyn u kala duwaan kartaa tayada mashruuca, sannadka, faa'idooyinka la wadaago, iyo shuruudaha iibsadaha. Credits-ka Madaxbanaanaha ee Green Gate lama sharci gelin borsadaha dadweynaha.
CarbonCredit.projects_subtitle: Mashruucyada offset carboonka ee madaxbanaanaha iyo kuwa shahaadadda caalamiga ah ee Somaliland — beerta dhirta, soo-celinta mangroves, carboonka buluugga ah, iyo hawlaha karbaashka nadiifka ah.
CarbonCredit.portfolio_subtitle: Isbeddellada 12 bilood ee soo-saarka credits-ka carboonka, hawl-dhaafka, iyo kaydka la heli karo ee dhammaan mashruucyada madaxbanaanaha ee Somaliland.
CarbonCredit.framework_subtitle: Dulmar ku saabsan aaladaha caalamiga ah ee xukumaya xaqiijinta, shahaadeynta, iyo ganacsiga xadka-gudbaya ee credits-ka carboonka oo ku haboon mashruucyada madaxbanaanaha ee Green Gate.
CarbonCredit.framework_disclaimer: Dulmarkan qaab-dhismeedka waa macluumaad uun. Green Gate waxay la jaanqaadaysaa credits-ka carboonka madaxbanaanaha ee Heshiiska Paris Maqaalka 6.2 iyo shuruudaha xaqiijinimada ACMI. Maamulayaasha mashruucyada waxay la tashanaan karaan xarunta shaqsiyeed ee loo magacaabay iyo hay'adda xaqiijinta (VVB) si ay u helaan shuruudaha shahaadeynta oo xaqiiq ah.

Projects.hero_badge: MASHAARIICDA CIMILADA EE MADAXBANNAAN EE SOMALILAND
Projects.hero_subtitle: La socod boortafoliyaha mashaariicda cagaaran iyo kaarboonka ee Somaliland — laga soo bilaabo canshuurta kaarboonka badda iyo dejinta diiwaanka qaranka ilaa ilaalinta kaarboonka buluugga, dib-u-dhirrigelinta, iyo kaba-beddelista tamarta nadiifta ah ee Dekadda Berbera.
Projects.grid_subtitle: Mashaariicda cimilada iyo kaarboonka ee madaxbannaan ee Somaliland — hadda socda, xaaladda diyaarinta, soo socda, ama dhameeyay.
Projects.timeline_subtitle: Taariikhyada muhiimka ah iyo marxaladaha boortafoliyaha mashaariicda cimilada ee madaxbannaan ee Somaliland — laga bilaabo xidhitaanka ACMI ee COP27 ilaa saarka deynta madaxbannaan ee kowaad ee 2026.
Projects.impact_subtitle: Faa'iidooyinka isku-dhafan ee dhammaan mashaariicda cimilada ee madaxbannaan — kaydinta CO₂, ilaalinta nidaamka deegaanka, nafaqada dadka, iyo waafaqa Yoolalka Horumarinta ee Joogtada ah.
Projects.partners_subtitle: Hay'adaha badan-geesoodka ah, hay'adaha UN, hay'adaha heerarka, iyo ururrada gobolka ee taageeraya istiraatijiyada maaliyadda cimilada ee madaxbannaan ee Somaliland.
Projects.partners_cta_subtitle: Ma hay'ad maaliyadeed ah oo horumarinta, hay'ad heerarka ah, ama NGO ah oo xiisaynaysa iskaashatada ama shahaadaynta mashruuc cimilo ah oo Somaliland?

Reports.hero_subtitle: Hel warbixinnado farsamo iyo dhaqaale oo dhamaystiran oo ku saabsan hababka kaarboonka ee badda Somaliland iyo mashaariicda kaabayaasha cimilada.
Reports.analytics_subtitle: Kormeerka bil-walba ee heerarka waafaqsanaanta, dakhliga la helayo, iyo cabbirrada taraafikada badda.
Reports.table_subtitle: Soo degso warbixinnada rasmiga ah ee qaabka PDF, CSV, ama XLSX.

About.hero_title_line1: Ciyaaryahan Afrikaan ah oo Xoog leh
About.hero_subtitle: Solide Technology, iyada oo loo marayo barnaamijka dhijitaalka ah ee Green Gate, waxay xaqiijinaysaa dowladaha dhammaan qaaradda adduunka inay tahay lammaane istaraatiiji ah oo adag oo xoojineysa qiimaha kheyraadka deegaanka iyo cagaarka.
About.mission_title: Xirfad Gudaha ah oo Heerarka Caalamiga ah Gaara
About.mission_desc: Suuqa kaariyada ee si dhakhso ah u isbedelaya ee qaaradda Afrika, hab-qaabinta xirfadda gudaha ah ee awood u leh inay gaaraan heerarka caalamiga ah waa lagama maarmaanka. Green Gate waxay muujisaa jiilka cusub ee hoggaamiyayaasha Afrika.
About.pillar_african_desc: Aqoonsigayaga Afrikaaniga ah ee gaar ah wuxuu ka baxsanayaa astaan kaliya. Wuxuu muujinayaa go'doomidda kor u kaceysa ee jiilka cusub ee hoggaamiyayaasha Afrika ee qaata mas'uuliyadda taariikhdda si Afrika isu go'aaminso, nafteeda lagu saleysan, oo ay u soo jeediso qaab dunida inteeda kale.
About.pillar_sovereignty_desc: Xal dhijitaal ah oo dammaanadeeya raadraaca, xornimada, iyo madaxbannaaanida gelitaanka iyo maaraynta xogta. Qalabtaan istaraatiijiga ah waxay xoojinaysaa xushmada caalamiga ah ee siyaasadaha maaraynta hantida deegaanka ee madaxbannaan.
About.pillar_expertise_desc: Gaarka-xilka ah kan wuxuu siinayaa xirfadda faham qoto dheer oo xaaladdaha dhaqan-dhaqaale ee maxaliga ah, taas oo dammaanad-gashaysa xalal ka wax ku ool ah oo xaaladda u habboon ah dowladaha iyo hawl-gelinayaasha Afrika.
About.founders_desc: Xalkan horumarinta hantida deegaanka wuxuu ka soo baxay is-dhexgalka waayo-aragnimada, xirfadda, iyo khibradda afar qof fikradeed.
About.founder_kpatchavi_bio: Agaasimaha Guud ee Solide Technology, aad u firfircoon sanado badan mashaaariicda waaweyn ee PPP (Iskaashiga Dadweynaha-Gaarka ah) iyo wareejinta tignoolajiyada iyo xirfadda qaaradda Afrika.
About.founder_radji_role: Xisaabiye Diiwansan — Hormuudka Maaliyadda Joogta ah
About.founder_radji_bio: Xisaabiye Diiwansan, hormuudka maaliyadda joogta ah ee Afrika iyo khubarada ikhtiraaca dhijitaalka ah. Si qoto dheer u lug leh mashaaariicda Iskaashiga Dadweynaha-Gaarka ah iyo wareejinta xirfadda dhammaan qaaradda.
About.blockchain_desc: Green Gate waxay bixisaa xal dhijitaal ah ku salaysan habayaasha blockchain, iyada oo dammaanad-gashaysa heerka ugu sarreeya ee kalsoonida maaraynta hantida deegaanka ee madaxbannaan.
About.blockchain_traceability_desc: Macaamiil kasta, qiimayn soo-saare kasta, iyo lacag-bixin kasta waxaa si joogto ah loogu diiwaan-geliyaa diiwaanka aan laga bedeli karin, iyada oo la bixinayo raad-xisaabinta dhamaystiran laga bilaabo gasashada markabka ilaa uruurinta canshuurta.
About.blockchain_transparency_desc: Dhammaan dhinacyada xiriirka — dowladaha, hawl-gelinayaasha, xisaabiyayaasha — si madaxbannaan ayay u xaqiijin karaan saxnaanta xogta iyada oon ku tiirsanayn xukumo dhexe, taas oo dhisaysa kalsoonida nidaamka.
About.blockchain_antifraud_desc: Dammaanadaha cryptographic waxay ka ilaaliyaan been-abuurka xogta, iyada oo dammaanad-gashaysa in qiimaynaha canshuurta deegaanka iyo kaariyada kaariyada aan la kicinkarin ama la jabin karin.
About.blockchain_sovereignty_desc: Dowladaha Afrika waxay hayaan xukun buuxda oo xogtooda deegaanka. Waara-tiirsanaanta dibadda la'aanta, deganaanshaha xog ajnabi la'aanta — madaxbannaaanida dhijitaalka ah ee buuxda ee qaaradda.
About.vision_title: Xarunta Daawada Afrika ee Kheyraadka Cimilada
About.vision_desc: Aragtida Solide Technology, barnaamijka Green Gate wuxuu noqon karaa mid ka mid ah qaababka ugu horeeyay ee Afrika ee isku-dhafan ee uruurinta canshuurta kaariyada iyo deegaanka dhammaan qaaradda.
About.vision_observatory: Soo jeedinta xarunta daawada Afrika ee dhabta ah ee arrimaha la xiriira uruurinta kheyraadka si loo tacaabilo caqabadaha isbedelka cimilada — taas oo oggolaaneysa dowlad kasta oo Afrikaan ah inay horumariso hantidooda deegaanka iyada oo la adeegsanayo qaababka dhijitaalka ah ee istaraatiijiga ee ikhtiraaca ah.
About.vision_cta: Ogso Nidaamka Dhijitaalka ah ee Green Gate

Partnership.hero_subtitle: Nidaamka Dijital ee Green Gate — barnaamij blockchain ah oo kacsan oo u oggolaanaya dhammaan dowladaha Afrikada inay qaataan xal dijital ah oo loogu talagalay uruurinta cashuurta carboon iyo deegaanka. Markii ugu horreysey waxaa lagu fuliyay dowladda yar ee Somaliland.
Partnership.deployment_title: Waxa Nidaamka Dijital ee Green Gate Bixiya
Partnership.deployment_desc: Iskaashantan ayaa dhawaan si muuqata u muuqatay markii heshiis weyn la saxiixay dowladda yar ee Somaliland, oo ku fulisa nidaam dijital ah oo kacsan oo loogu talagalay uruurinta cashuurta carboon iyo deegaanka ee xukuumadda.
Partnership.cap_digital_desc: Nidaam maarayn dijital ah oo heer sare ah oo u oggolaanaya dowladaha inay hagaajiyaan uruurinta cashuurta carboon iyo deegaanka si tayo, sax-naanta, iyo kormeerka deg-degga ah oo aan hore loogu arag.
Partnership.cap_blockchain_desc: Lagu dhisay tignoolajiyada blockchain oo hubinaya la-socodka, madax-bannaanida, iyo xukuumadda gelitaanka iyo maaraynta xogta, iyadoo looga ilaalinayo khataraha khiyaanada iyo been-abuurka.
Partnership.cap_compliance_desc: Waafaqsanaanta buuxda ee IMO, EU ETS, Heshiiska Paris Maqaaladiisa 6.2 iyo 6.4, iyo heerarka ACMI — oo saara dowladaha iskaashiga hore ee xukuumadda deegaanka caalamiga ah.
Partnership.cap_optimization_desc: Xukumad shaqeed oo si gaar ah ugu dhisan qalab dijital oo heer sare ah oo u oggolaanaya dowladaha inay si hawl-gal ah ugu maarayaan hantidooda deegaanka iyada oo loo marayo awoodaha maaraynta xeeladda ee hal abuurka ah.
Partnership.impact_desc: Solide Technology waxay isu dhigtaa lamaane heer-caalami ah, oo awood u leh in ay bixiso xal dijital ah oo saara dowladaha Afrikada horena ka dhiga maaraynta shaafafka, adag, hufnaanta, iyo xukuumadda ee hantida deegaanka iyo cagaarka.

Ascr.arch_title: Sida ASCR iyo Green Gate Uga Shaqeeyaan Wada-jir
Ascr.arch_desc: ASCR waa diiwaanka iyo lakabka maaraynta — waxay qeexdaa qaab-dhismeedka polluter-pays oo ansixisaa kirasyada kaarbuunka. Green Gate waa lakabka hawlgalka — waxay ogaataa maraakiibta, xisaabisaa saadaasha, soo saartaa biilasha, oo u soosaaraa lacagaha. Waxay is-dhammaysiraan, maaha tartanayaal.
Ascr.int_policy_desc: Heerkarka canshuurta iyo hab-raacyada saadaasha ee Green Gate waxay la-jaanqaadaan Qaab-dhismeedka Polluter Pays ee ASCR, iyaga oo hubinaya in canshuuraha kaarbuunka ee dowladda ay raacaan heerarka AU-la ansixiyay.
Ascr.int_registry_desc: Xogta uruurinta ee Green Gate waxaa lagu warbixin karaa diiwaanka qaranka ee ASCR, oo bixinaya xogta saadaasha iyo dakhliga la xaqiijiyay ee warbixinta caalamiga ah ee cimilada (NDCs, Paris Art. 6.2).
Ascr.int_compliance_desc: Qaab-dhismeedka xaqiijinta dhinaca saddexaad ee ASCR waxaa ku dabaqmaa jeeggaga raadaynta ee Green Gate — diiwaanada la xidid hash waxay bixiyaan hufnaanta looga baahan yahay shahaadada ASCR.
Ascr.int_interop_desc: API-ga Green Gate waxaa loogu naqshadeeyay isku-dhafka kaabayaasha diiwaanka dhijitaalka ah ee ASCR, taas oo u awood yeelinaysa is-weydaarsiga xogta tooska ah ee nidaamka uruurinta iyo diiwaanka xiddigta.
Ascr.cta_desc: Haddii dalkaagu yahay qeyb ka mid ah qaab-dhismeedka ASCR ama la filaayo uruurinta canshuurta kaarbuunka ee dowladda, Green Gate waxay bixisaa kaabayaasha hawlgalka si tan loo dhaliyo.

DashboardPages.simulator_faq_a1: Canshuurta waxay ku salaysantahay qiyaasta soo-saarka CO2 iyada oo la adeegsanayo hab-raacyada IMO SFOC (Isticmaalka Shidaalka Gaaska Gaar ah). Soo-saarka = isticmaalka shidaalka x faktorka soo-saarka CO2. Canshuurta = soo-saarka x heerka rasmi ah x ku-dhufashada aagga.
DashboardPages.simulator_faq_q2: Maxay kala duduwan yihiin canshuurta EEZ iyo canshuurta dekadda?
DashboardPages.simulator_faq_a2: Canshuurta EEZ waxay daboolaysaa taraasiidka Aagga Dhaqaale ee Gaar ah (200 NM). Canshuurta dekadda waxay khusaysaa inta lagu jiro joogista dekadda (matoorada la-dheefsiineed). Heerarka iyo ku-dhufashada waxay ku kala duwanaan karaan aagga.
DashboardPages.simulator_faq_a3: Maya. Qiyaastan waa tilmaanayaal. Biilka kama-dambaysta ah (pro-forma) wuxuu ku xisaabtamaa xogta AIS ee dhabta ah ee laga duubay safarkiinna EEZ-ka iyo dekadda.
DashboardPages.simulator_faq_a4: Isticmaalka Shidaalka Gaaska Gaar ah (g/kWh) wuxuu cabbiraa isticmaalka shidaalka midkiiba xoogga matoorada soo saarayo. Nooc kasta oo markab ah wuxuu leeyahay SFOC-ga celceliska ah. Qiyaas sax ah, adeegsiga SFOC-ga dhabta ah ee markabkaaga.
DashboardPages.simulator_faq_q5: Sideen u yareyn karaa canshuurta kaarboonkayga?
DashboardPages.simulator_faq_a5: Yareey xawlaha (socodka gaaban), adeegsiga shidaalka CO2 yar (LNG, methanol), hagaaji muddada joogista dekadda, ama hel ciyaaraha kaarboonka iyada oo loo marayo mashaariicda Green Gate ee la xaqiijiyay.
DashboardPages.simulator_faq_a6: Haa. Markabka cilmi-baarista, maraakiibta ciidanka, iyo markabyo gaara ee heshiisyada labajibbaaran waxay faa'iideysan karaan ka-dhaafid qayb ama dhamaanba. La xiriir xukuumadda dekadda si aad macluumaad dheeraad ah u hesho.

TermsOfService.subtitle: Shuruudahan Adeegga waxay xukumaan gelitaanka iyo isticmaalka Barnaamijka Macluumaadka Kaariyada Badda ee Green Gate, oo ah nidaam dhijitaal ah oo madaxbannaan oo uu maareeyo Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland si loo maareeyo canshuurta kaariyada badda ee Gobolka Dhaqaalaaha ee Gacanka Aden.
TermsOfService.section_01_highlight: Markaad isdiiwaan-geliso, gasho, ama isticmaasho barnaamijka Green Gate, waxaad xaqiijinaysaa inaad akhrisan tahay, fahmay, oo aad ku heshay xasillooni buuxda Shuruudahan Adeegga, Siyaasadda Gaarka ah, Sharciga Kaariyada Badda 2024, iyo dhammaan xeerarka dekedda ee ay soo saartay Hay'adda Canshuurta Kaariyada Badda ee Somaliland (SMCA). Haddaadan ogolaanin, laguma oggolaan karo inaad gasho barnaamijka.
TermsOfService.section_01_p1: Isticmaalayaasha Hay'adda Dekedda (shaqaalaha dowladda), Shuruudahan waxay dheereeyaan oo kuma beddelaan waajibaadkaaga hoos timaada sharciga adeegga dadweynaha Somaliland iyo tilmaamaha gudaha ee Wasaaradda Maaliyadda. Wakiilada Maraakiibta iyo Armateurs-ka, Shuruudahan waxay u dhigantahay heshiis sharciyeed xaddidan oo u dhexeeya ururkaaga iyo SMCA laga bilaabo marka la diiwaangeliyo akoonka.
TermsOfService.section_01_p2: SMCA waxay xaq u leedahay inay wax ka beddesho Shuruudahan goor kasta. Isticmaalka joogtada ah ee barnaamijka kadib ogeysiiska isbedelada waxay u dhigantahay oggolaanshaha Shuruudaha la cusbooneysiiyay.
TermsOfService.section_02_def_platform: Barnaamijka Macluumaadka Kaariyada Badda ee Green Gate, oo ay ku jiraan dhammaan xasabadaha shabakadda, API-yada, iyo adeegyada dhijitaalka ah ee la xiriira.
TermsOfService.section_02_def_smca: Hay'adda Canshuurta Kaariyada Badda ee Somaliland, oo ah hay'ad xeerka hoos timaada Wasaaradda Maaliyadda oo mas'uul ka ah maaraynta canshuurta kaariyada.
TermsOfService.section_02_def_eez: Gobolka Dhaqaalaaha Gaar ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, oo u fidiya 200 mayl badnimo laga bilaabo xaddiga aasaasiga ah, oo ku jira biyaha Gacanka Aden ee hoos yimaada xukun Somaliland.
TermsOfService.section_02_def_user: Qof dabiici ah ama shakhsiga sharciga ah oo lagu siiyay gelitaanka Barnaamijka, oo ay ku jiraan Saraakiisha Dekedda, Maamulayaasha Maaliyadda, Xisaabiyayaasha Waafaqsanaanta, Wakiilada Maraakiibta, iyo Maamulayaasha Kooxda.
TermsOfService.section_02_def_vessel: Markab, doon, ama gaari-badeed kasta oo hoos yimaada Sharciga Kaariyada Badda 2024, oo ay ku jiraan maraakiibta xamuulka, markabadka badeecada, tankiyaha, markabadka xoqida, iyo doonyaha boqortooyada ee loo yaqaan gross tonnage ≥400 GT.
TermsOfService.section_02_def_carbon_tax: Canshuurta kaariyada badda ee la xisaabiyaa halkii tan oo CO₂-la mid ah oo la soo saaro, sida uu qeexayo Sharciga Kaariyada Badda 2024 iyo Habaynta Canshuurta ee Khuseysa.
TermsOfService.section_02_def_proforma: Faatuurad hore oo uu soo saaro Barnaamijka oo dukumeyneysa waajibaadka canshuurta kaariyada ee la qiyaasay ee booqasho deked gaar ah ama gudbinta EEZ.
TermsOfService.section_02_def_ais: Xogta booska iyo xiriirka badda ee nidaamka Aqoonsiga Tooska ah (AIS) ee ay baahiyaan maraakiibtu oo ay helaan qaababka xeebta ee hoos yimaada xukun Somaliland.
TermsOfService.section_02_def_audit_log: Diiwaanka aan laga bedeli karin, oo leh silsilad hash-cryptographic ah, oo ay ku jiraan dhammaan ficilada isticmaalayaasha ee Barnaamijka, oo lagu kaydiyay kaabayaasha xogta ee madaxbannaan ee Somaliland.
TermsOfService.section_02_def_carbon_credits: Unugyada Yaraynta Soo-saarka ee la xaqiijiyay (VER) oo ay soo saartay SMCA oo mataleysa hal tan oo CO₂ la mid ah oo la helin ama la dhammeeyay.
TermsOfService.section_03_p1: Gelitaanka Green Gate waxaa loo xaddidaa qaybaha isticmaalayaasha soo socda:
TermsOfService.section_03_li1: Isticmaalayaasha Hay'adda Dekedda: Shaqaalaha firfircoon ee dowladda Somaliland, hay'adaha dekedda oo la aqoonsaday, ama wasaaradaha, oo haysata cinwaanka email rasmi ah oo sax ah (tusaale, domain @gov.sl). Akoonnadda waxay u baahan yihiin oggolaanshaha Maamulaha Barnaamijka oo leh fasaxa SUPERADMIN.
TermsOfService.section_03_li2: Wakiilada Maraakiibta & Armateurs-ka: Shirkadaha sharciga ah oo la diiwaangeliyay ama ganacsatada kali ah oo leh ugu yaraan hal markab oo lagu diiwaangeliyay IMO oo ka shaqeysa ama maraya EEZ Somaliland. Diiwaan-gelinta waxay u baahan tahay Lambarka Shaqaynta IMO oo sax ah iyo diiwaan-gelinta ganacsiga oo SMCA xaqiijiyay.
TermsOfService.section_03_p2: Dhammaan akoonnadda waxaa lagu xaqiijiyaa aqoonsiga ka hor firfircoonyaanshaha. SMCA waxay xaq u leedahay inay diiwan-gelinta diiido ama ka noqoto, goorteedii oo ay doonto, iyada oo aan waajibaad lahayn inay sababaha bixiso, marka ay la xiriirto ammaanka qaranka ama danaha xakamaynta canshuurta.
TermsOfService.section_03_warning: Siyaasadda Akoonta Hal ah: Qof kasta wuxuu heli karaa hal akoonto firfircoon oo keliya. Uruuradu waxay hayn karaan akoonno badan oo wakiilada kala duwan ee la oggolaay, laakiin akoonto kasta waa inay la xiriirto qof gaar ah oo keli ah. Wadaagga xogta sirdoonka aad ayaa looga mamnuucay oo waxay horseedaysaa joojinta akoonka si deg deg ah.
TermsOfService.section_04_p1: Dhammaan isticmaalayaasha Barnaamijka waxay ku heshaan:
TermsOfService.section_04_li1: In la bixiyo macluumaad sax ah, dhamaystiran, oo casri ah inta lagu jiro diiwaan-gelinta iyo waqtiga isticmaalka Barnaamijka.
TermsOfService.section_04_li2: In la dhawro sirta xogta sirdoonka oo isla markiiba SMCA lagu ogeysiiyay security@smca.gov.sl hadday shaki ku jirto gelitaan aan la oggolayn oo akoonkoda ah.
TermsOfService.section_04_li3: In Barnaamijka loo isticmaalo ujeeddooyinkiisa sharciga ah oo keliya — waafaqsanaanta canshuurta, maaraynta faatuurada, kormeerka kooxda, iyo warbixinta — oo uusan loo isticmaalin wax ujeedo ganacsi, macluumaad tartameed, ama ujeeddo aan la oggolayn.
TermsOfService.section_04_li4: In la waafaqo dhammaan shuruucda khuseysa, oo ay ku jiraan Sharciga Kaariyada Badda 2024, Sharciga Maamulka Canshuurta ee Somaliland 2023, IMO MARPOL Annex VI, iyo heshiisyada caalamiga ah ee badda oo Somaliland ka xubin tahay.
TermsOfService.section_04_li5: In la aqbalo in dhammaan ficilada lagu sameeyay Barnaamijka lagu kaydiyo diiwaanka xisaabaadka aan laga bedeli karin oo laga isticmaali karo caddeyn xukumaadda ama dacwadaha dembiga.
TermsOfService.section_04_li6: In aan la wareejin, loo joojiyo, ama laga faragelin wax sifo ammaanka ah oo Barnaamijka, oo ay ku jiraan hannaanada xaqiijinta, xaddideyaasha xaddida, iyo xukumaadka gelitaanka.
TermsOfService.section_04_additional_label: Waajibaadyo Dheeraad ah — Wakiilada Maraakiibta & Armateurs-ka
TermsOfService.section_04_li7: In la xaqiijiyo in dhammaan maraakiibta hoos yimaada maarayntaada si sax ah loogu diiwaangeliyo Barnaamijka, oo ay ku jiraan lambarada IMO ee sax ah, gobolada calanka, iyo culayska guud.
TermsOfService.section_04_li8: In lagu jawaabo faatuuradaha hore iyo codsiyada lacag-bixinta muddooyinka ku qoran Sharciga Kaariyada Badda 2024 (48 saacadood faatuuradaha caadiga ah, 24 saacadood ogeysiisyada xakamaynta degdegga ah).
TermsOfService.section_04_li9: In SMCA lagu ogeysiiyay wax kasta oo isbedel ah oo kicin kooxa, wareejinta lahaanshaha, ama isbedel calanka ah muddo 5 maalmood oo ganacsi ah.
TermsOfService.section_05_highlight: Canshuurta kaariyada badda waa qalab maaliyadeed madaxbannaan oo Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, oo lagu aasaasay hoos timaada Sharciga Kaariyada Badda 2024 oo khuseysa dhammaan maraakiibta ganacsiga ee 400 GT ama ka sareeya ee galaya, maraya, ama joogta EEZ Somaliland. Bixinta canshuurta kaariyada waa waajibaad sharciyeed, ma ahan ikhtiyaar, kacdoonka bixinta waa dambi maaliyadeed.
TermsOfService.section_05_row1_trigger: Markab u gudbaya xaddiga EEZ-ka si dhex-dhexaad ah
TermsOfService.section_05_row2_trigger: Markab ku degaya Berbera, Zeila, ama dekedo la aqoonsaday
TermsOfService.section_05_row2_window: 24 saacadood laga bilaabo bixitaanka faatuuradda hore
TermsOfService.section_05_row3_trigger: Markab maraya iyada oo aan booqasho deked lahayn (≥12 saacadood EEZ-ka)
TermsOfService.section_05_row4_trigger: Muddo kasta oo 24 saacadood ah oo dheeraanshaha joogitaanka dekedda ka dib 48 saacadood
TermsOfService.section_05_row4_window: Faatuurad maalinlaha ah, muddo lacag-bixinta 24 saacadood
TermsOfService.section_05_p1: Heerarka canshuurta kaariyada waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa halkii tan oo CO₂-la mid ah oo la soo saaro, iyada oo la adeegsanayo habka IMO Energy Efficiency Operational Indicator (EEOI) ama, haddii xogta matoorka ay diyaar tahay, xisaabinta tooska ah ee ku saleysan SFOC. Heerarka waxaa lagu daabacaa Habaynta Canshuurta ee qaybinta maraakiibta iyo gobolka maxkamadda, sida laga arki karo Goobaha Canshuurta ee Barnaamijka.
TermsOfService.section_05_p2: Maraakiibtu waxay codsanaanaan karaan xornimada hoos timaada Qodobka 17 ee Sharciga Kaariyada Badda 2024 (maraakiibta ciidanku ee heshiisyada labada geesood, maraakiibta gargaarka bini'aadamiga, maraakiibta halis ah). Xornimadu waxay u baahan tahay oggolaanshaha wasiirnimada oo waxay xaddidantahay waqtiga. Codsiyada xornimada khiyaanada waa dambi dambiyeed.
TermsOfService.section_06_li1: Faatuuradaha hore waxaa si toos ah u soo saara Barnaamijka iyadoo ku saleysan xogta AIS iyo habaynta canshuurta. Waa dukumentiyo codsiga sharciga ah oo ansax ah hoos timaada sharciga canshuurta Somaliland.
TermsOfService.section_06_li2: Lacag-bixinta waxaa lagu samayn karaa: (i) wareejinta lacagta SWIFT oo u socota akoonka Khazanadda SMCA, (ii) adeegyada escrow badda oo la oggolaay, ama (iii) tirtirka xagga kaariyada (haddaan xaq u lahayn).
TermsOfService.section_06_li3: Faatuuradaha aan lacagta lagu bixin mudada la cayimay waxaa kor loogu qaadaa heerka OVERDUE. Maraakiibta howshooda dhameeyay waxay u nugul yihiin kilinka iridda dekedda, amarrada xabsiga markabka, iyo u gudbinta Wasaaradda Caddaaladda.
TermsOfService.section_06_li4: Khilaafyada lacag-bixinta waa in lagu gudbiyaa qoraal muddo 10 maalmood oo ganacsi ah laga bilaabo bixitaanka faatuuradda oo loo dirayo disputes@smca.gov.sl. Gudbinta khilaafku kama joojiso waajibaadka lacag-bixinta haddayan SMCA bixinin joojinta xakamaynta si cad.
TermsOfService.section_06_li5: Lacagaha dheeraadka ah waxaa dib loo celiyaa muddo 30 maalmood oo ganacsi ah, ama waxaa loo xisaabiyaa waajibaadyada canshuurta mustaqbalka iyada oo lagu salaynayo ikhtiyaarka hawl-geliyaha.
TermsOfService.section_06_warning: Kilinka Iridda Dekedda: Maraakiibta leh xaaladda OVERDUE waxaa laga yaabaa inay la kulaan Amarka Kilinka Iridda Dekedda, oo ka hortagaya baxitaanka dekedda Berbera ama Zeila ilaa bixinta buuxda la xaqiijiyo. SMCA kama mas'uulid khasaaraha ganacsiga ee ka yimaada xakamaynta sharciga ah ee maraakiibta waafaqsanaanta.Somaliland.
TermsOfService.section_07_p1: Ficilada soo socda aad bay uga mamnuuc tahay waxayna horseeday karaan joojinta akoonka si deg deg ah, u gudbinta dacwad dambiyeed, ama mas'uuliyadda madaniga ah:
TermsOfService.section_07_li1: Gelitaanka aan la oggolayn ee akoonka ama xogta isticmaale kale, oo ay ku jiraan wadaagga xogta sirdoonka, hijacking-ka xaaladda, ama injineernimada bulshada.
TermsOfService.section_07_li2: Tirtirka ama isku dayo wax-ka-beddelka xogta AIS, diiwaangelinta maraakiibta, qiyaasaha soo-saarka, ama gelitaanka xisaabinta canshuurta.
TermsOfService.section_07_li3: Gudbin macluumaad been ah ama khiyaano ah oo diiwaan-gelinta, codsiyada xornimada, ama diiwaangelinta maraakiibta.
TermsOfService.section_07_li4: Duubista toos ah, dejinta xog badan, ama soo-saarka nidaamsan ee xogta Barnaamijka iyada oon hore loo helin oggolaansha qoraaleed ee SMCA.
TermsOfService.section_07_li5: Injineernimada dib u dib u celinta, furista, ama isku day lagu soo saaro koodka asalka ah ama xisaabyada ganacsiga ee Barnaamijka.
TermsOfService.section_07_li6: Isticmaalka Barnaamijka ama xogta ka timaadda si looga sameeyo alaabta macluumaadka ganacsiga, adeegyada raadraaca badda oo saddexaad, ama falanqaynta tartanka iyada oon lahayn ruqsadda xogta SMCA.
TermsOfService.section_07_li7: Faragalinta helitaanka Barnaamijka iyada oo la adeegsanayo weerarada diid-adeegga, codsiyada toos ah ee xad-dhaafka, ama xaaladda xun ee API.
TermsOfService.section_07_li8: Muujinta xogta sirta ah ee Barnaamijka (marka laga reebo diiwaannada shakhsiga ah) dhinacyada aan la oggolayn.
TermsOfService.section_08_p1: Barnaamijka Green Gate, oo ay ku jiraan koodhkiisa asalka ah, naqshadaynta, xisaabyada, qaababka xisaabinta kaariyada badda, qaab-dhismeedka shashada, iyo dukumeentiyada, waa hantida garaadka madaxbannaan ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, oo ay maamulayso Wasaaradda Maaliyadda. Dhammaan xuquuqda way xirnantahay.
TermsOfService.section_08_p2: Isticmaalayaasha waxaa la siiyay ruqsad xaddidan, aan gaar u ahayn, aan la wareejin karin, oo la noqon karo si loo helo oo loo isticmaalo Barnaamijka oo keliya ujeeddooyinkoodii la oggolaay sida ku qoran Shuruudahan. Wax ruqsad ah kama jirto soo-saarka, qaybinta, sinaynta, ama abuurista shaqooyinka ku salaysan natiijada Barnaamijka.
TermsOfService.section_08_p3: Xogta ay isticmaalayaashu gudbiyaan (xogta markabka, macluumaadka shirkadda) waxay ahaanaysaa hantida dhinaca gudbiya laakiin waxaa ruqsad bixiya SMCA si looga isticmaalo dhammaan ujeeddooyinka lagama maarmaanka u ah fulinta amar xeer-dajiga ah, oo ay ku jiraan xakamaynta canshuurta, warbixinta kaariyada, iyo ilaalinta diiwaanka xisaabaadka.
TermsOfService.section_09_highlight: Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxay ku dhawaaqday xukun madaxbannaan oo buuxda dhammaan xogta la soo saaray, la uruuriyay, la hawl-geliyay, oo lagu kaydiyay barnaamijka Green Gate. Madaxbannaaanida xogtu waa mabaadi'da aan laga xaajoodin ee barnaamijkan waxayna dammaanad gasho hoos timaada Sharciga Kaariyada Badda 2024 iyo sharciyadda ilaalinta xogta ee Somaliland ee khuseysa.
TermsOfService.section_09_p1: Dammaanadaha soo socda waxay khusaanaan dhammaan xogta ay Barnaamijku hawl-geliyo:
TermsOfService.section_09_li1: Lahaanshaha Dowladda: Dhammaan xogta la soo saaray iyada oo la hawl-gelinayo Barnaamijka — oo ay ku jiraan diiwaannada raadraaca AIS, xisaabinta canshuurta, qiyaasaha soo-saarka, diiwaannada xisaabaadka, iyo diiwaannada kaariyada — waxay ahaanaysaa hantida madaxbannaan ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, oo uu maamulayo SMCA behalf Wasaaradda Maaliyadda.
TermsOfService.section_09_li2: Martigelinta Maxkamadeed: Dhammaan kaabayaasha kaydinta xogta asalka ah waa inay ku yaalaan gudaha maxkamadda ay dooratay Dowladda ku milanayd ama, ugu yaraan, gudaha maxkamadda bixisa heerarka ilaalinta xogta la mid ah. SMCA waxay bixin doontaa shahaadada qoraaleed ee goobaha martigelinta xogta marka la codsado.
TermsOfService.section_09_li3: La'aanta Wareejinta Saddexaad: Wax xog ah kama wareejin doonto, la wadaagi doono, ama loo heli doono wax dhinac saddexaad ah — oo ay ku jiraan iibiyayaasha tignoolajiyada, shirkadaha hoostimaadka, ama dowladaha ajnabiga — iyada oon lahayn ogolaansha qoraaleed ee cad ee SMCA. Tani waxay ku jiraan xogta sumadda la gooyay ama kooxda haddaan si gaar ah loogu oggolaanin.
TermsOfService.section_09_li4: Xaqa Xisaabaadka: Dowladda ku milanayd waxay xaq u leedahay inay sameyso xisaabado madaxbannaan oo kaabayaasha kaydinta xogta, xukumaadka gelitaanka, heerarka sirta, iyo nidaamyada kaydka ee goor kasta ah, iyada oo la ogeysiinayo 10 maalmood oo ganacsi ah qoraaleed. SMCA waxay fududaynaysaa xisaabadaas iyada oon qaadin kharashaad dheeraad ah.
TermsOfService.section_09_li5: Dammaanadda Deganaanshaha Xogta: Marka la codsado, SMCA waxay bixin doontaa Shahaadada Deganaanshaha Xogta oo qeexa goobaha jirka ah ee dhammaan serverrada, xasaabaadka kaydka, iyo goobaha soo-celinta halis ah ee xogta Barnaamijka lagu kaydiyay ama lagu nuqul-samayn doono.
TermsOfService.section_09_warning: Jabinta Madaxbannaaanida Xogta: Wareejinta, nuqul-samaaynta, ama gelitaanka aan la oggolayn ee xogta madaxbannaan waxay u dhigantahay jabinta Sharciga Kaariyada Badda 2024 oo waxay horseeday karaan dacwad dembiyeedka hoos timaada sharciga Somaliland, joojinta heshiiska, iyo sheegashada khasaaraha.
TermsOfService.section_10_highlight: Dhammaan isticmaalayaasha barnaamijka Green Gate waxay leeyihiin xaq aan shartiyo lahayn si ay uga soo dhoofiyaan xogtooda waqtiga la doono, qaabab furan oo dukumeynaysan, iyada oon xaddidaad vendor lock-in lahayn. Xaqan waxaa lagu dammaanadnaqaa qayb ka dab xaaladda akoonka, khilaafyada heshiiska, ama waajibaadyada lacag-bixinta.
TermsOfService.section_10_p1: Xaqa Dhoofinta Xogta waxaa ku jira dammaanadaha soo socda:
TermsOfService.section_10_li1: Dhoofinta Buuxda ee Xogta: Isticmaalayaashu waxay codsan karaan dhoofinta dhamaystiran ee dhammaan xogta la xiriirta akoonkooda, oo ay ku jiraan diiwaannada markabka, taariikhdda macaamil-ganacsiga, faatuuradaha, xisaabinta soo-saarka, diiwaannada xisaabaadka, iyo diiwaannada khilaafyada. Dhoofinta waxay ku diyaar tahay qaababka CSV, JSON, iyo PDF.
TermsOfService.section_10_li2: Wakhtiga Keenista: SMCA waxay keeni doontaa dhoofinta xogta la codsaday muddo ugu badan 72 saacadood laga bilaabo helitaanka codsi dhoofin ah oo sax ah. Dhoofinta is-adeegga tooska ah (iyada oo la adeegsanayo shashada Barnaamijka) waxay si deg deg ah u diyaar noqon doontaa xog-ururintaha ka yar 50 MB.
TermsOfService.section_10_li3: Qaababka Furan: Dhammaan xogta la dhoofiyay waxaa lagu keeni doonaa qaababka furan, dukumeynaysan, ee makiinadda akhrisan karta (CSV madaxyo leh, JSON dokumenti-qoraalka leh, PDF/A faatuuradaha). Wax qaab ganacsiga ama sir ah oo u baahan software SMCA-gaar ah si loo akhriyo.
TermsOfService.section_10_li4: La'aanta Xaddidaadda Vendor: Qaabka dhoofinta xogta waa in si ku filan loo dukumeeyaa oo loo nidaamiyo si loo ogolaado u guurid platform ama nidaam kasta oo kale iyada oon waayoonu khasaaranin xogta. SMCA waxay bixin doontaa Dukumeentiga Qaamuuska Xogta leh dhoofin kasta marka la codsado.
TermsOfService.section_10_li5: Ilaalinta ka Dib Joojinta: Kadib joojinta heshiiska ama baajinta akoonka, SMCA waxay ilaaliyaa dhammaan xogta isticmaalaha muddo ugu yaraan 90 maalmood oo tirinaaya, xilligaan isticmaaluhu wuxuu codsan karaa dhoofinta kama-dambeysta. Kadib mudadda ilaalinta, xogta si joogto ah oo aan la soo celin karin ayaa laga tirayaa, iyada oo la bixinayo xaqiijinta qoraaleed ee isticmaalaha.
TermsOfService.section_10_li6: Canshuuraha Dhoofinta la'aanta: Dhoofintaha xogta caadiga ah waxaa lagu bixiyaa iyada oon qaadin kharashaad dheeraad ah. SMCA waxay qaadi kartaa lacago macquul ah oo keliya qaababka dhoofinta gaar ah, dib-u-dhisidda xogta taariikhdda, ama dhoofintaha u baahan faragelin gacan-si-gacan ah, iyadoo lacagta la muujinayo hore.
TermsOfService.section_10_p2: Codsiyada dhoofinta waxaa lagu gudbiyaa shashada Barnaamijka (Goobta → Dhoofinta Xogtayda) ama codsi qoraaleed oo loo diraya data-export@smca.gov.sl.
TermsOfService.section_11_p1: Barnaamijku waxaa lagu bixiyaa adeeg dhijitaal ah oo dowladda madaxbannaan ah. Xadka ugu sarreeya ee uu u oggolaado sharciga khuseeya:

PrivacyPolicy.title: Siyaasadda Xogta Gaarka ah
PrivacyPolicy.subtitle: Dokumankan wuxuu sharxayaa sida Dowladda Somaliland, iyada oo loo marayo platform-ka Green Gate, ay u uruurisaa, u farsamaysaa, u kaydisaa, oo ay u ilaalisaa xogta shakhsiga ee ku xidha maaraynta canshuurta kaarbuunka badda iyo kormeerka deegaanka ee dowladda.
PrivacyPolicy.section_01_p1: Platform-ka Green Gate Maritime Carbon Intelligence waxaa maamula Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland (halkan ka dib "Wasaaradda") ee u matashaa Somaliland Maritime Carbon Authority (SMCA). Platform-kan wuxuu uruuriyaa oo uu farsamaynayaa xogta shakhsiga iyo ee hay'adaha oo qeyb ka ah waajibkiisa sharciyeed ee maaraynta canshuurta kaarbuunka badda, xaqiijinta hoggaaminta deegaanka, iyo soo xasiilinta dakhliga dowladda ee Gobolka Dhaqaalaha Ee Xiddigta (EEZ) ee Gacanka Aden.
PrivacyPolicy.section_01_highlight: Siyaasaddan Xogta Gaarka ah waxaa lagu aasaasay Somaliland Data Protection Act 2023, mabda'yada African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention, 2014), IMO Maritime Cyber Risk Management Guidelines (MSC-FAL.1/Circ.3), iyo Maritime Carbon Act 2024. Halka khuseeya, waxaan sidoo kale la-jaanqaadinaa dhaqankeena iyo EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR 2016/679) ee dadka ku nool ama ku xidhan maamulka Yurubta.
PrivacyPolicy.section_01_p2: Dhammaan hawlaha farsamaynta waxaa xukuma Somaliland Data Protection Commissioner (SDPC) waxaana lagu diwaan-galinayaa diiwaanka rasmiga ah ee qaranka ee farsamaynta xogta. Siyaasaddan waxay khusaysaa dhammaan isticmaalayaasha Green Gate, oo ay ku jiraan saraakiisha Xukuumadda Dekedda, Maamulayaasha Maaliyadda, Wakiiladda Maraakiibta, iyo Asxaabta Maraakiibta.

PrivacyPolicy.section_03_cat_b_li5: Taariikhdda soo-galaynta dekedda, bayaanada xamuulka, iyo diiwaanka biilasha hore

PrivacyPolicy.section_03_cat_c_li2: Xogta farsamada maraakiibta: miisaanka guud, xoogga matoorka, xawliga naqshadeynta

PrivacyPolicy.section_05_p1: Farsamaynta xogta shakhsiga ee Green Gate waxay ku salaysan tahay aasaasyada sharciga ee soo socda ee ka bilaabmaya Somaliland Data Protection Act 2023 iyo qaababkii caalamiga ah ee la-jaanqaaday:
PrivacyPolicy.section_05_li1: Waajibka Sharciga (Qod. 6(1)(c) la mid ah): Maritime Carbon Act 2024, IMO MARPOL Annex VI, Somaliland Finance Act 2024 — farsamayntu waa waajib ee xaqiijinta canshuurta mana diidin karto dadka xogtooda ah ee EEZ ku hawlgala.
PrivacyPolicy.section_05_li2: Hawsha Guud (Qod. 6(1)(e) la mid ah): Amarkii dowladnimada ee SMCA ee kormeerka, xukumidda, iyo warbixinta saadaasha kaarbuunka gudaha maamulka badda Somaliland.
PrivacyPolicy.section_05_li3: Danaha Sharci ah (Qod. 6(1)(f) la mid ah): Amniga platform-ka, ka-hortagga khiyaanada, iyo diiwaanka jeegga aan la beddeli karin — la miisaamay xuquuqda dadka xogtooda ah waxaana lagu diiwaangeliyay Qiimeynteena Danaha Sharci ah (LIA/2024-03).
PrivacyPolicy.section_05_li4: Baahida Heshiiska (Qod. 6(1)(b) la mid ah): Wakiiladda Maraakiibta iyo Asxaabta Maraakiibta ee platform-ka ku diiwaan-galiya, farsamayntu waxay baahida u tahay fulinta heshiiska adeegyada dhijitaalka ah iyo waajibka lacag-bixinta canshuurta.
PrivacyPolicy.section_05_warning: Ogeysiis ku saabsan Xogta Xasaasiga ah: Green Gate kuma farsamayso qaybaha gaar ah ee xogta shakhsiga (caafimaadka, bayoolajiga, dhinaca siyaasadda) oo ah macnaha Qod. 9 GDPR ama sharciga u dhigma ee Somaliland. Xogta goobta AIS ee maraakiibta lama tixgelin xogta shakhsiga ee qaamuuska badda laakiin waxaa lala macaamilaa heerarka amniga u dhigma.
PrivacyPolicy.section_06_p1: Marka mudada haysiintu dhammaato, xogta waxaa si ammaan ah loogu tirtiraa adeegsiga qarsoodi cryptographic (qoraal-bedelka + burburinta furahaaha) ama waxaa la magac-daafaa si looga isticmaalo xisaabaadka. Diiwaanada tirtirka laftigood waxaa la hayaa 2 sano.
PrivacyPolicy.section_07_p1: Xogta shakhsiga kama gadanno, kama kiraynno, ama si ganacsiga ah uma wareejinno. Xogta waxaa la wadaagi kara oo kaliya xaaladahan soo socda:
PrivacyPolicy.section_07_li1: International Maritime Organization (IMO): Tirakoobka saadaasha oo uruursan oo aan aqoonsiga lagu oran, waxaa si sanadleh loo gudbinaaa oo uu ka hooseeyo waajibka warbixinta MARPOL Annex VI.
PrivacyPolicy.section_07_li2: African Union / ITPGRFA: Xogta deegaanka oo la wadaagay oo qeyb ka ah xilqaadyada cimilada ee xiddigta Somaliland — marnaba heer maraakiib gaar ah la'aanta aasaaska sharciga cad.
PrivacyPolicy.section_07_li3: Hay'adaha Xeebeynta Deriska ah (Djibouti, Eritrea): Xogta goobta maraakiibta ee la baarayaa ee ku aaddan ka-baxitaanka hoggaaminta, oo lagu heshiiyay heshiisyada badda ee lamaanaha.
PrivacyPolicy.section_07_li4: Wasaaradda Cadaaladda: Diiwaanka jeegga iyo diiwaanada maaliyadda ee xaaladaha baaritaanka dembiga, oo loo baahan yahay ogolaanshaha garsoorka.
PrivacyPolicy.section_07_li5: Farsamo-Bixiyeyaasha: Adeegyada kaabayaasha daruuraha iyo kaydiyaha xogta ee ku howlgala dhulka Somaliland (BER-DC1) ama loo baahan yahay qaababka ilaalinta xogta ku habboon. Dhammaan farsamaynayaasha waxaa xidha Heshiisyada Farsamaynta Xogta (DPAs).
PrivacyPolicy.section_07_warning: Wareejinnada caalamiga ah ee dibadda Afrika: Wareejinta xogta shakhsiga dalalka aan loo aqoon inay bixiyaan ilaalin ku filan waxay u baahan tahay Clauses-yada Heshiiska Caadiga ah (SCCs) oo loo baahan yahay ogolaanshaha SDPC. Wareejinta culayska xogta asxaabta maraakiibta ama shirkadaha howlgalka dalalka aan ku filnayn la'aanta ruqsad cad lama samayso.
PrivacyPolicy.section_08_p1: Iyada oo loo eegayo sharciga khuseeya Somaliland iyo xaddidaadyada hawlgalka, dadka xogtooda waxay leeyihiin xuquuqdan soo socda. Qaar ka mid ah xuquuqaha waxaa laga xaddidi karaa halka ay faragelin lahayeen waajibka farsamaynta sharciga qasabka ah (tusaale, xaqiijinta canshuurta, aan la beddeli karin jeegga):

PrivacyPolicy.section_08_row2_limitation: Diiwaanada jeegga naqshaddan kama beddeli karo — lama beddeli karo

PrivacyPolicy.section_08_row5_limitation: Waxaa heli kara xogta akoonka; kuma khuseyso xogta maraakiibta ama AIS
PrivacyPolicy.section_08_row6_scope: Ka-diidashada farsamaynta oo ku salaysan danaha sharci ah

PrivacyPolicy.section_08_p2: Si aad u isticmaasho xuquuqdaada, codso qoraal u dir dpo@smca.gov.sl oo ku jiro caddaynta aqoonsigaaga. Waxaan ka jawaabi doonaa 30 maalmood taariikheed ah. Codsiyada adag ama badan waxaa lagu kordhin karaa 60 maalmood oo dheeraad ah oo ogeysiis leh.
PrivacyPolicy.section_09_highlight: Nidaamka Aqoonsiga Tooska ah (AIS) waa nidaam raadiyaha lama huri maana ah ee qaamuuska IMO SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 19. Xogta AIS ee maraakiibtu u ergen EEZ-ga Somaliland waxaa helaya xabbadaha ku taal dhulka xeebta ee dowladda waxaana loo aqoonsan yahay xogta farsamada ee hantida guud ee ka hooseysa sharciga caalamiga ah ee badda. Uruurinteeda iyo isticmaalkeeda ee amniga, deegaanka, iyo ujeedooyinka xaqiijinta canshuurta kuma baahna ogolaanshaha gaar ah ee asxaabta maraakiibta.
PrivacyPolicy.section_09_p1: Gudaha Green Gate, xogta AIS waxaa si gaar ah loogu isticmaalaa: (i) aqoonsiga maraakiibta gudaha EEZ ee qiimeynta canshuurta kaarbuunka, (ii) xisaabinta saadaasha CO₂ la qiyaasay oo ku saleysan xawliga maraakiibta, goobta, iyo xogta matoorka, (iii) soo-saarida biilasha hore iyo ogeysiisyada hoggaaminta, iyo (iv) buuxinta muuqaalka khaariidadda ee Xarunta Amarka ee saraakiisha ogolaanshaha leh.
PrivacyPolicy.section_09_p2: Xogta goobta AIS marnaba lama isticmaalo raadaynta ganacsiga, lama iibiyo dhinacyada saddexaad, ama lama wadaago marka laga baxo ujeedooyinka kore. Feedo-yada AIS ee khaam waxaa la hayaa 2 sano ka dibna waxaa laga nadiifiyaa nidaamyada koowaad.
PrivacyPolicy.section_10_p1: Green Gate waxay hirgelisaa nidaam amniga oo dhawr-dhinac leh oo waafaqsan ISO/IEC 27001:2022, tilmaamaha IMO Maritime Cyber Risk Management, iyo NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF 2.0):
PrivacyPolicy.section_10_li1: Qarsoodi marka la kaydinayo: AES-256 dhammaan xogta la kaydiyay, oo leh modules-ka amniga hardware (HSMs) ee maaraynta furahaaha ee BER-DC1.
PrivacyPolicy.section_10_li2: Qarsoodi marka la gudbinayo: TLS 1.3 dhammaan gaadiidka API iyo websaydhka. Noocyada duugga ah ee TLS (≤1.2) waxaa diidaya load balancer-ka.
PrivacyPolicy.section_10_li3: Xukumida gelitaanka: Xukumida Gelitaanka Ku Saleysan Doorka (RBAC) oo leh mabda'yada awood-yarida ugu yar. Dhammaan ficilada amar-sarreeya waxay u baahan tahay MFA. Ficilada superadmin waxay u baahan tahay ogolaanshaha laba-dhinac.
PrivacyPolicy.section_10_li4: Diiwaanka jeeg aan la beddeli karin: Dhammaan ficilada hawlwadeenka waxaa la xidid SHA-256 hash-chain oo lagu kaydiyaa diiwaanka ka-hortagga-tacadiida oo kaliya-kudaraya.
PrivacyPolicy.section_10_li5: Baaritaanka gelitaanka: Baaritaanada gelitaanka ee sanadlaha ah ee dhinacyada saddexaad ee xilqaadka. Natiijooyinka waxaa lagu ogaysiiyaa warbixinta Baaritaanka Amniga.
PrivacyPolicy.section_10_li6: Ka-jawaabidda xaaladaha degdegga ah: Ogeysiinta dhibaatada xogta SDPC gudaha 72 saacadood, dadka xogtooda saameynta ku leh gudaha 5 maalmood shaqo, oo waafaqsan Qod. 33–34 GDPR ee u dhigma.
PrivacyPolicy.section_11_p1: Green Gate waxay isticmaashaa cookies iyo tokens-ka fadhiga ee baahida oo keliya. Cookieyada xayeysiiska, falanqaynta, ama raadaynta lama isticmaalo.

PrivacyPolicy.section_11_p2: Fadhiyada waxay si toos ah u dhameystamaan ka dib 15 daqiiqo oo aan hawl lahayn oo ah tallaaboy amni. Isticmaalayaashu kama joojin karaan tan. Tokens-ka fadhiga waxaa ka baabi'iyaa server-ka marka la baxo oo lama isticmaali karo mar labaad.

PrivacyPolicy.section_12_p1: Haddaad rumeyso in xuquuqdaada gaarka ah la xadgudbay, waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad gudbiso cabashada Somaliland Data Protection Commissioner (SDPC) waqti kasta, iyada oon loo eegin wax xal ah oo maamul ama maxkamadeed. Xiriirka SDPC waxaa heli kara sdpc.gov.sl.
PrivacyPolicy.section_12_highlight: Siyaasaddan Xogta Gaarka ah waxaa dib loo eegay oo la ansixiyay Safiirka Ilaalinta Xogta ee Somaliland Maarso 1, 2025. Isbeddelada siyaasaddan waxaa lagu daabici doonaa ugu yaraan 30 maalmood ka hor inta aysan dhaqangelin, oo leh ogeysiis loo diray dhammaan isticmaalayaasha platform-ka diiwaan-galsan email-ka.

SecurityAudit.title: Warbixinta Baarista Amniga
SecurityAudit.subtitle: Dukumigankan waxa uu soo bandhigayaa natiijooyinka baarista amniga ee platform-ka Green Gate, oo ay ku jiraan dib-u-eegista qaab-dhismeedka, natiijooyinka tijaabada xusulka, qiimaynta u hogaansamida ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0, iyo tilmaamaha Maaraynta Khatarta Cyber ee IMO, iyo qorshaha amniga ee SMCA.
SecurityAudit.section_01_highlight: Green Gate waxa loo guddoomay shahaadada ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ee Nidaamka Maaraynta Amniga Macluumaadka (ISMS) oo daboolaya Xarunta Xogta Berbera (BER-DC1) iyo dhammaan qaybaha platform-ka. Baarista dibadda ee sanadlaha ah waxa la sameeyay Bureau Veritas Certification (oo ay ogolaadeen UKAS) Janaayo 2025. Wax natiijooyiin muhiim ah ama heer sare oo furan ah kuma jiraan taariikhda warbixintan.
SecurityAudit.section_02_p1: Baarista amniga ee sanadlaha ah ee 2025 waxa la sameeyay inta u dhaxaysa Janaayo 6 ilaa 31, 2025 koox madax-bannaan oo ka kooban:
SecurityAudit.section_02_li1: Baaraha Dibadda: Bureau Veritas Certification — Baarayaasha Hogaaminta ISO 27001 (shahaadada LA-27001)
SecurityAudit.section_02_li2: Kooxda Tijaabada Xusulka: CyberNile Security Ltd. (Nairobi / Djibouti) — Baarayaal shahaadada OSCP, CEH, iyo CISM leh
SecurityAudit.section_02_li3: Kormeerka Baarista Gudaha: Madaxa Amniga Macluumaadka (CISO) ee SMCA iyo DPO
SecurityAudit.section_02_p2: Baarista waxa ay dabooshay qaybahan iyo xudduudahan:
SecurityAudit.section_02_row2_scope: Xaqiijinta, ogolaanshaha, ansaxinta gelitaanka, xaddidaadda codsiyada
SecurityAudit.section_02_row2_methodology: Sanduuqa ceeriin + API fuzzing (Burp Suite Pro)
SecurityAudit.section_02_row3_scope: Amniga heerka saf, SQL injection, kor u qaadista xuquuqda
SecurityAudit.section_02_row4_scope: Kalsoonida xogta, dhibcaha galinta, helitaanka aan oggolaansho lahayn
SecurityAudit.section_02_row5_scope: Xeerarka dab-damiska, kala soocida shabakadda, go'naanshaha VLAN
SecurityAudit.section_02_row6_scope: Siyaasadaha amniga Pod, maaraynta siraha, isbaahaysiga sawirrada
SecurityAudit.section_03_p1: Green Gate waxa lagu maamuus gareeyaa kaabayaasha madax-bannaan oo awood ah in la kala gooyo hawada ee BER-DC1, Berbera, Somaliland. Qaab-dhismeedku waxa uu raacayaa qaabka difaaca-dhismeed-hoose oo leh lakabyo amniga madaxbannaan oo badan:
SecurityAudit.section_03_li1: Xuduudda Dibadda: Qalab looga hortago DDoS (Arbor Networks), shaandhaynta gelitaanka, iyo Suurtogalnimada Codsiga Web (WAF) oo leh xeer-gaar u ah qaababka API-ga badda. Dhammaan gaadiidka dibadda waxa uu ku dhammaadaa WAF-ka ka hor inta uusan gaarin serveryadda codsiga.
SecurityAudit.section_03_li2: Kala-soocida Shabakadda: Shabakadaha wax-soo-saarka, tijaabada, iyo maamulka si jireed ayaa loogu kala saaray VLAN-yo gaar ah oo leh toosinta dhexe ee VLAN khasaaraha ka dhigta hardware-ka dab-damiska (Fortinet FortiGate 600E). Shabakadda galitaanka xogta AIS waxa laga go'doomiyay shabakadda codsiga.
SecurityAudit.section_03_li3: Lakabka Codsiga: Hordhaca Next.js waxa laga adeegsiiyaa xaaladaha Node.js la adkeeyay. API-ga backend Go leh saxiixida codsiga, xaddidaadda codsiyada (100 codsiga/daqiiqad hal isticmaale oo xaqiijiyay), iyo ansaxinta gelitaanka adag ee schema-yada Zod.
SecurityAudit.section_03_li4: Lakabka Kaydka Xogta: PostgreSQL (Supabase) leh siyaasadaha Amniga Heerka Saf (RLS) oo lagu xukumay heerka kaydka xogta dhammaan miisaska. Sirreeynta heerka tiirka ee xogta dhaqaalaha adeegsiga pgcrypto leh furaha HSM-ka.
SecurityAudit.section_03_li5: Lakabka Baaritaanka: Kaydka baaritaanka u-gali-kaliya ee ah kaydka ee leh xirxirida hash SHA-256. Adeegga baaritaanka waxa uu ku shaqeeyaa konteynar go'doon ah oo aan lahayn oggolaanshaha qorista xogta wax-soo-saarka — oo keliya dhacdooyinka ka helo API qorista kaliya ee xaqiijiyay.
SecurityAudit.section_03_li6: Maaraynta Siraha: HashiCorp Vault (xaaladda BER-DC1) dhammaan siraha, furaha API, iyo xogta xusuusta kaydka xogta. Wax sir ah kuma kaydna doobiyada deegaanka ama sawirrada konteynar. Wareejinta sir-toosinta ah 90 maalmood kasta.
SecurityAudit.section_04_row1_implementation: 4 door: PORT_OFFICER, FINANCE_ADMIN, COMPLIANCE_AUDITOR, SUPERADMIN — lagu xukumay heerka API iyo kaydka xogta
SecurityAudit.section_04_row2_implementation: TOTP (RFC 6238) oo waajib ah SUPERADMIN; dhammaanba isticmaalayaasha; lagu xukumay siyaasadda dhammaan hawlgallada dhaqaalaha
SecurityAudit.section_04_row3_implementation: JWT oo dhammaadka 15-daqiiqo, cookies HTTP-kaliya, SameSite=Strict, cusboonaysiinta tooska ah marka howlaha socotaan, joojinta dhinaca server-ka marka la baxo
SecurityAudit.section_04_row4_implementation: Hawlgallada SUPERADMIN waxay u baahan yihiin habka oggolaanshaha laba-geesoodka. Dhammaan fadhiyada xaq-u-laha waxa la duubaa waa la dib-u-eegaa usbuucii kasta.
SecurityAudit.section_04_row5_implementation: Min 8 xaraf, kuxigeenka muhiim, bcrypt hashing (qadar 12), ma isticmaalaan xog-ururin isla mar 12 wareeg, hubinta API HaveIBeenPwned marka la diiwaangeliyayo
SecurityAudit.section_04_row6_implementation: Xadhiga xisaabta kadib 5 isku-day oo fashilmay; dib-u-dhac kordhaya; CAPTCHA kadib 3 fashil; xaddidaadda heerka IP
SecurityAudit.section_04_row7_implementation: SSH ku-salaysan shahaadada kaliya (ma jirto xaqiijin eray-sir). Xerada madaxa ah oo waajib ah. Dhammaan fadhiyada waxa la duubaa waa la diiwaangeliyaa.
SecurityAudit.section_04_row8_implementation: Bearer token (JWT) dhammaan codsiyada API; furaha API adeeg-ilaa-adeeg (HMAC-SHA256 la saxiixay); ma jiro fur API URL-ka
SecurityAudit.section_05_row2_algorithm: AES-256-CBC oo leh fure gaara set kaydsi kasta
SecurityAudit.section_05_row3_key_mgmt: Let's Encrypt + CA-ga dhexe ee SMCA
SecurityAudit.section_05_row5_key_mgmt: Fure xidid fur-ka hawada — saxiixida daah-furka hawada
SecurityAudit.section_05_row6_key_mgmt: Shahaadada saxiixida rasmiga ah ee SMCA (X.509 v3)
SecurityAudit.section_05_row8_key_mgmt: Ma galin fure — hash hal-arag ah
SecurityAudit.section_05_p1: Dhammaan modules-ka cryptographic-ga ee loo isticmalo Green Gate waxa ay ansaxsan yihiin FIPS 140-3 (shahaadooyinka #4765, #4822). Cipher suites-ka hoose TLS 1.3 waxa la joojiyay load balancer-ka. Cipher suites-ka dhigan-soo-saarka, madhan, iyo RC4 marnaba lama shaqayn.
SecurityAudit.section_06_highlight: Diiwaanka baaritaanka ee Green Gate waa aasaaska xisaabtanka platform-ka. Dhammaan howlgallada isticmaalaha, isbedelada siyaasadda, helitaanka xogta, iyo dhacdooyinka nidaamka waxay abuuraan gelitaan diiwan baaritaan oo aan beddeli karin. Gelitaannada lama tirtiri karo, wax lagama beddeli karo, wala nadiifin karo wax isticmaale ah — oo ay ku jirto SUPERADMIN. Hawlgalka kaliya ee la oggolaadey waa kudarista.
SecurityAudit.section_06_p1: Fulinta farsamo ee aan la beddeli karin diiwaanka baaritaanka:
SecurityAudit.section_06_li1: Xirxirida hash: Gelitaan kasta oo diiwan waxaa ku jira hash SHA-256 ee gelitaankii hore, oo samaynaysa silsilad xaqiijin karo. Wax kasta oo lagu beddelo gelitaan taariikheed ah wuxuu baabi'inayaa hash-yada soo socdaa oo dhammaantood, taasoo sameynaysa og-yaab xawaaradeed.
SecurityAudit.section_06_li2: API baaritaanka qor-kaliya: Adeegga baaritaanka waxa uu muujiyaa keliya endpoint POST. Ma jirto endpoint GET (akhri), PUT (cusboonaysii), ama DELETE heerka adeegga. Helitaanka akhrisku wuxuu kaga yimaadaa nuqul gaar ah oo akhris-kaliya ah.
SecurityAudit.section_06_li3: Kaydsi maalinlaha ah oo goob-shisheeye ah: Diiwaanka baaritaanka oo buuxa waxa la kaydiyaa maalin kasta nidaamo kaydsi ah oo hawada laga gooyo ee Wasaaradda Caddaaladda. Kalsoonida kaydsigu waxa ay xaqiijisaa saxiixyo Ed25519.
SecurityAudit.section_06_li4: Hubinta kalsoonida silsilada: Shaqo toos ah ayaa 6 saacadood kasta u socda si ay u xaqiijiso kalsoonida silsilada hash-ka oo dhammaanteeda. Digniin ayaa loo diraa CISO-ga iyo Agaasimaha SMCA haddii wax khalad ah la ogaado.
SecurityAudit.section_06_li5: Xuquuqda sharciga: Diiwaanka baaritaanka waxa loo aqbalay xog-ragaad elektaroonik ah oo la aqbali karo Maxkamadda Ganacsiga Somaliland (Dacwadda SCC-2024-117). Kalsoonidiisu waxa ay xaqiijisaa Machadka Cilmi-baadista Qaranka.
SecurityAudit.section_07_li1: Ximaayadda DDoS: Arbor Networks Sightline (hardware) + Cloudflare Magic Transit looga hortago weerarrada cufnaanta. Awoodda la tijaabiyay: ilaa 40 Gbps. Dhacdada DDoS-ka ugu dambeysay: midna lama diiwaangeliyin 2024.
SecurityAudit.section_07_li2: WAF: ModSecurity leh OWASP CRS v3.3.4 + xeerarka gaar u ah endpoints API-ga badda. Celceliska heerka been-abuurka: 0.02%.
SecurityAudit.section_07_li3: Ogaanshaha/Ka-hortagga Xusulka (IDS/IPS): Suricata oo ku baahsan dhammaan meelaha shabakadda. Saxiixyo waxa la cusboonaysiiyaa 4 saacadood kasta. Digniimuhu waxay kiciyaan buugaagta hawlgallada jawaabta tooska ah (Shuffle SOAR).
SecurityAudit.section_07_li4: Helitaanka Shabakadda Aamini-la'aanta (ZTNA): Helitaanka maamulka kaabayaasha BER-DC1 wuxuu u baahan yahay Cloudflare Access (ZTNA) leh xaqiijinta aqoonsiga, xitaa VPN-ka gudaha. La fuliyay Q4 2024.
SecurityAudit.section_07_li5: Go'naanshaha Xogta AIS: Shabakadda qaadista AIS si jireed ayaa laga go'doomiyay internet-ka. Xogta waxa loo wareejiyaa shabakadda codsiga mid-ahaanshaha xogta hal-geed (Waterfall Security WF-500). Ma jirto jid soo-noqosho ah.
SecurityAudit.section_07_li6: Amniga BGP: Lambarku SMCA AS waxa uu ku xiran yahay RPKI (Ogolaanshaha Asal-Geediga Jidka). Dhammaan fadhiyada BGP waxay adeegsadaan xaqiijinta MD5 waa lagu shaandhaynayaa liisaska hordhaca.
SecurityAudit.section_08_warning: Xusid Masuulnimo ah: Warbixintan dadweynaha u ah waxa ay ka kooban tahay kooban natiijooyinka keliya. Natiijooyinka farsamo ee faahfaahsan, xusulka-cadaynta, iyo koodka hagaajinta waxa lagu sifeeye waxaana heli kara keliya CISO ee SMCA, DPO, iyo wakiilada ansaxay Wasaaradda Caddaaladda ee heshiiska sirta hoostiisa.
SecurityAudit.section_08_row1_remediation: Hubinta dheeraadka ah ee RBAC middleware — la hagaajiyay Febraayo 2025
SecurityAudit.section_08_row2_remediation: Nadiifinta gelitaanka la adkeeyay — la hagaajiyay Janaayo 2025
SecurityAudit.section_08_row3_remediation: Cinwaannada CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options waxa lagu daray — la hagaajiyay Janaayo 2025
SecurityAudit.section_08_row4_remediation: Jawaabaha khaladaadka guud ee wax-soo-saarka — la hagaajiyay Janaayo 2025
SecurityAudit.section_08_row5_remediation: Nidaaminta IP + xaddidaadda heerka aqoonsiga JWT — la hagaajiyay Febraayo 2025
SecurityAudit.section_08_highlight: Wax natiijooyiin Muhiim ah ama Heer-sare ah kuma laan tijaabada xusulka Q1 2025. Dhammaan natiijooyinka Dhexdhexaadka ah waxa la hagaajiyay gudaha 15 maalmood kadib bayaanka. Wax xad-gudub xog, helitaan aan oggolaansho lahayn, ama kor u qaadis xuquuq ah kuma guulaysan muddada tijaabada la fasaxay. Kooxda tijaabada xusulka waxa ay platform-ka siisay dhibcaha bisaynta amniga 8.2/10.
SecurityAudit.section_09_row03_scope: Khatar cyber ee Nidaamka Maaraynta Amniga
SecurityAudit.section_09_row08_status: K/M — Xog kaar ah lama kaydiyay
SecurityAudit.section_10_p1: Green Gate waxa uu maamuusaa Barnaamijka Rasmiga ah ee Maaraynta Dayacmada (VMP) ee u hogaansan ISO 27001:2022 Annex A.8.8:
SecurityAudit.section_10_li1: Isbaahaysiga joogtada ah: Isbaahaysiga dayacmada ee tooska ah waxa uu maalintiiba u socdaa dhammaan konteynarrka (Trivy), xiriirayaasha (Dependabot + Snyk), iyo kaabayaasha (Tenable.io). Natiijooyinka waxa la qiimeeyaa 24 saacadood gudahood.
SecurityAudit.section_10_li2: SLA-yada ku-dheelitirnaanta: Muhiim — 24 saacadood; Sare — 7 maalmood; Dhexdhexaad — 30 maalmood; Hoose — 90 maalmood. Habka ku-dheelitirnaanta xawaaradeed waxa uu jiraa zero-days (bartilmaameed: 4 saacadood).
SecurityAudit.section_10_li3: Maaraynta xiriirayaasha: Xiriirayaasha Node.js iyo Go waxa lagu xidiyay faylasha khitaarka. Dhammaan xiriirayaasha taranka waxa la dib-u-eegaa. npm audit iyo go mod verify waxa ay ku shaqeeyaan tuunka CI/CD.
SecurityAudit.section_10_li4: Siyaasadda zero-day: Quudiyada macluumaadka khatarta firfircoon (CISA KEV, CERT-EU, AfricaCERT). SMCA waa xubinta shabakadda xiriirka qaranka AfricaCERT.
SecurityAudit.section_10_row1_component: Qalab gudaha (aan u soo gelin platform-ka)
SecurityAudit.section_11_p1: SMCA waxa uu hayaa Qorshaha Jawaabta Dhacdooyinka (IRP) ee rasmiga ah oo waafaqsan NIST SP 800-61r3 iyo ISO/IEC 27035:2023. Qorshaha waxa la tijaabiyaa rubuc sanadlaha ah iyada oo loo adeegsanayo xeladaha shaxda iyo sannadle oo loo adeegsanayo xaalad buuxda ee kooxda cas.
SecurityAudit.section_11_row1_procedure: Digniimuhu SIEM (Wazuh), kiciyaha IDS, wariyada isticmaalaha, hubinta kalsoonida tooska ah
SecurityAudit.section_11_row2_procedure: Qiimeynta CISO + Kooxda Amniga, kala-soocida heerka xumaaanta (P1–P4)
SecurityAudit.section_11_row3_procedure: Go'naanshaha tooska ah ee nidaamyada saameynta; maaraynta gacanta ee CISO
SecurityAudit.section_11_row4_procedure: Falanqaynta sababta xididka, baahinta ku-dheelitirnaanta, adkeynta qaabeynta
SecurityAudit.section_11_row5_procedure: Soo-celinta adeegga kaydsooyinka nadiifka ah; hubinta kalsoonida
SecurityAudit.section_11_row6_procedure: Warbixinta PIR, waxbarashada la bartay, horumarinta xukumida, ogeysiiska SDPC haddii xog la xaddo
SecurityAudit.section_11_highlight: Taariikhda Dhacdooyinka Amniga 2024: Eber (0) xad-gudub xog oo la xaqiijiyay. Saddex (3) isku-day helitaan aan oggolaansho lahayn oo la ogaaday, la joojiyay, waa loo warisay Somaliland CERT. Mid (1) isku-day xaaladda raadraaca email ah oo u jeeda Sarkaalka Dekadda — uu joojiyay xarunta amniga email-ka. Wax guulaystay oo platform-ka lagu weeraray kuma diiwaangalin 2024.
SecurityAudit.section_12_row01_initiative: Shahaadada SOC 2 Nooca II (Amniga + Helitaanka + Sirta)
SecurityAudit.section_12_row02_initiative: Fure Amniga Hardware (FIDO2/WebAuthn) MFA dhammaan isticmaalayaasha SUPERADMIN
SecurityAudit.section_12_row03_initiative: Baahinta Qaab-dhismeedka Aamini-la'aanta dhammaan adeegyada gudaha (Istio + SPIFFE)
SecurityAudit.section_12_row04_initiative: Cusboonaysiinta wakhtiga dhabta ah ee SIEM (Maaraynta Macluumaadka & Dhacdooyinka Amniga) ilaa Wazuh 4.8
SecurityAudit.section_12_row05_initiative: Dashboard kormeerka u hogaansamida tooska ah (xukumida ISO 27001)
SecurityAudit.section_12_row06_initiative: Tijaabada xusulka labo-jeer sanadkiiba (kor uga badisay sanadlaha)
SecurityAudit.section_12_row07_initiative: Amniga silsilada sahayda — daabacaadda SBOM (Liiska Walxaha Software-ka)
SecurityAudit.section_12_row08_initiative: CIS Controls v8 IG2 — gaar u gaaro 18/18 fulinta oo dhamaystiran
SecurityAudit.section_12_row09_initiative: Xubnimada rasmiga ah ee AfricaCERT iyo heshiiska wadaagga khatarta
SecurityAudit.section_12_row10_initiative: Qiimeynta cryptography-ga adkeynta quantum (heerarka NIST PQC)
SecurityAudit.section_12_p1: Horumarinta amniga waxa lagu daba-galaa Diiwaanka Horumarinta Joogtada ah ee Amniga Macluumaadka SMCA (ISCIL/2025) waxaana dib-u-eegaa bishii kasta CISO, DPO, iyo Agaasimaha SMCA. Horumarka waxa sanadkiiba loo soo gudbiyaa Wasaaradda Maaliyadda waxaana lagu daray daabacaadda xigta ee warbixintan Baarista Amniga ee dadweynaha.
SecurityAudit.section_12_warning: Barnaamijka Xusidda Masuulnimada: SMCA waxa uu maamuusaa barnaamij xusid masuulnimo ah cilmi-baarayaasha amniga. Haddaad ka hesho dayacma amnig ah Green Gate, fadlan uga war-bi security@smca.gov.sl oo adeegsanaya encryption PGP (furaha waxaa ka heli kartaa smca.gov.sl/pgp). Waanu ballan-qaadnaa inaan warbixinnada u aqbalano 48 saacadood gudahood iyo in dayacmada la xaqiijiyay ku xalliyo SLA-hayagankeena caadiga ah. Wax tallaabo sharci ah kuma qaadanno cilmi-baarayaasha raacaya mabaadi'da xusidda masuulnimada.
